item.title: Nevada Contractor License: 15 Questions People Ask, Answered
item.description: Every Nevada contractor license takes the Business and Law (CMS) exam plus a trade exam at PSI, four years of experience and a bond. Here are straight answers to the 15 questions people search most. Each answer is short, plain and checked against the official board and exam sources.
